scope: Apply the October 15 critique of E58 (Text style popover and Caption style panel): make the caption panel's controls visible and self-describing, rebuild the four caption pickers as one menu family, and replace E14's navigation to archived E58-E60 with context-preserving overlays.
approach: Fixes were made in components (Field, Menu item, Caption style, Editor state sources) so all consumers inherit them; node IDs of linked frames (E58 popover 993:117693, E59 993:117899, E60 993:118110) were kept by turning them into wrappers around state-source instances.

The Plugin API cannot set overlay position (overlayPositionType is read-only), so anchored menus follow the Page 26 overlay pattern: a transparent 1440x900 frame with a Close backdrop (click closes), Esc (key 27) closes, and the menu placed under its chip, flipping above when it would pass the bottom edge.
Reactions sit on the chip and menu-item instances, not on separate hotspot frames, so later copy or layout edits cannot strand them.
Caption edits apply on choice and Undo reverts (interaction contract: edits are previewed and committed as editor changes), so Close, Apply colour, Keep bottom centre and Cancel were removed.
